notes:
Inbound self-serve signup from indie dev founder (solo). Wants a hosted API — lowest friction.

Signup details / behavior: 
- 2026-02-10: account created via sign-up form; credit card added, started free credits.
- 2026-02-15: ran initial smoke tests (chat, completions). ~18k tokens used in first week, then dropped.
- 2026-03-02: optional intro call recorded (Fireflies id ff_2026-03-02_5142) — founder said: "building a lightweight pair-programming assistant for hobby devs; cost must stay < $200/mo initially."
- 2026-03-08: opened docs on model selection and batching; tried embeddings for small doc search proof-of-concept.
- 2026-03-10: hit soft rate limit; in-app message popped. User asked via support widget about burst capacity and whether Redwood has Llama2 variants available.

Technical / product notes: 
- Workload: interactive chat + short code completions, occasional embeddings for repo search. Low concurrency, spiky during evenings.
- Latency targets: tolerate ~200-400ms median for chat completions; needs <800ms 95p for a good UX.
- Throughput: small — ~5–20 reqs/min during spikes; not enterprise throughput.
- Cost sensitivity: high; founder expects to keep costs under ~$200/mo while validating product-market fit.
- Model preference: open models preferred for cost; asked about Redwood-curated open models and quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: would like automatic fallback to cheaper variant if budget triggers — asked if that exists today.
- Security: simple needs — basic audit logging sufficient for now; no SSO required. Public cloud okay (deploy to hosted API).

Sales/engagement notes: 
- No AE outreach yet; owner assigned by SFDC automation (Jordan Kim) but garden-variety PLG lead.
- Good candidate to convert via in-app conversion flows and usage nudges; low likelihood of enterprise motion unless volume grows.
- Potential upsell triggers: predictable burst limits, clearer pricing estimate for code workloads, pre-bundled token packs.

Next steps / recommended ops: 
- Engineering: add a short KB snippet for "expected token cost for common code completions" and link into in-app tips.
- Growth: schedule a targeted in-app email if they exceed 1k requests/week offering 15-min Q&A.
- Sales: leave as self-serve; flag for AE outreach only if monthly spend > $500 or explicit demo request.
